description: This Java source file defines the MqttProtocolAdapterProperties class, which extends ProtocolAdapterProperties. It encapsulates configuration properties specific to an MQTT protocol adapter, including the command acknowledgment timeout setting with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: MqttProtocolAdapterProperties
classes.description: A class that holds configuration properties for MQTT protocol adapters, including the command acknowledgment timeout.

methods.name: getCommandAckTimeout
methods.description: Returns the current command acknowledgment timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: setCommandAckTimeout
methods.description: Sets the command acknowledgment timeout in milliseconds; throws IllegalArgumentException if a negative value is provided.
